en: Old monochrome postcard showing a large Baroque/neo‑Classical civic building on a cobblestoned main square. The façade has tall shuttered windows, a central triangular pediment with a round oculus, coats‑of‑arms/medallions between the upper windows, and a flagpole on the ridge. People in early‑1900s dress and a cyclist cross the square; to the right stands a smaller pavilion-like building with three arched motifs and a circular window.
